question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

The play I saw last night was a ________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'****smash hit****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"smash hit"** means something that is a great success, especially a play, film, or song. (बड़ी सफलता)
 
• **​**The correct word **"smash hit"** refers to a production or performance that is extremely successful.
 
 
• **Example: **The new movie became a **smash hit** and broke all box office records
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hit the road **(रास्ते पर निकलना): To begin a journey or leave a place.

 
 
• **Example:** We need to **hit the road** early if we want to reach the campsite before dark.
 
 
 
• **Hit the hay **(सोने जाना): To go to bed.
 
 
• **Example: **After a long day at work, I decided to **hit the hay** early.
 
 
 
• **Hit the roof** (गुस्से से उबलना): To become very angry.
 
 
• **Example:** When he found out about the broken vase, he **hit the roof**.
